meta.name: hunt-ldap
meta.description: Hunt LDAP Injection and XPath Injection — authentication bypass, blind char-by-char attribute exfiltration, AD user/group enumeration, XML-store XPath bypass. Covers the LDAP special-character set (* ( ) \ NUL /), search-filter-context vs DN-injection, parenthesis-balancing, AND/OR filter logic, and {SSHA}/{CRYPT} userPassword exfil on non-AD directories. Use when target uses LDAP/AD authentication, corporate SSO with a directory backend, an address-book/people-search API, or XML-based data stores queried with XPath.

copy.tagline: 检测并利用LDAP与XPath注入漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在LDAP/AD认证或XPath查询中寻找注入漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Detect and exploit LDAP and XPath injection vulnerabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find injection flaws in LDAP/AD authentication or XPath queries.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你测试网站是否存在 LDAP 注入或 XPath 注入漏洞，包括绕过登录、逐字符窃取数据、枚举用户和组。
howto.when: 当目标网站使用 LDAP/AD 认证、企业 SSO、通讯录搜索 API 或 XML 数据存储时触发。

say.text: 测试这个登录页面是否存在 LDAP 注入。
say.note: Claude 会发送测试 payload 并分析响应。

say.text: 尝试绕过这个 LDAP 认证。
枚举这个 AD 域中的用户名。
say.note: Claude 会使用通配符搜索并统计结果。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you test websites for LDAP injection or XPath injection vulnerabilities, including authentication bypass, blind character-by-character data exfiltration, and user/group enumeration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the target uses LDAP/AD authentication, corporate SSO, an address-book/people-search API, or XML-based data stores queried with XPath.

say_en.text: Test this login page for LDAP injection.
say_en.note: Claude will send test payloads and analyze responses.

say_en.text: Try to bypass this LDAP authentication.
say_en.note: Claude will construct bypass payloads and check for successful login.

say_en.text: Enumerate usernames in this AD domain.
say_en.note: Claude will use wildcard searches and count results.
